title: 18051 - 18051/P1643/005699
commonCauses: Fault Code stored in Central Electronic Kontrol Modülü (J519/#09)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Central Electronic Kontrol Modülü (J519/#09) for Fault Codes
technicalNotes:
This Fault Code is only a Note referring to relevant Fault Codes stored in another Kontrol Modülü.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: 2.0l TFSI (AXX/BPY/BWA etc.), Kontrol edin: Steering Wheel Elektroniği for Cruise Control related Fault Codes and general Cruise Control Functionality. See TPI 2017317 for Details.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
